description:
Apify AI Agent allows this AI Digital Employee to securely connect with Apify and discover, run, and read results from Apify Store Actors (scrapers, crawlers, AI agents, and MCP-server Actors) using natural language.
The agent can search the Apify Store for Actors, fetch an Actor's details and input schema, start and monitor Actor runs, abort running Actors, and read results from datasets and key-value stores, strictly based on the permissions granted to the connected Apify API token.
